documents.method: Pinned extracted Spark worker versus timing-only instrumented worker, same WASM module and preloaded original SPZ/AP16. One warmup plus four samples per fresh document; documents scheduled ABBA per scene. Raw input copy, hashes and module import outside timing; original SplatLoader still copies internally. Main round trip is same-clock request-to-reply including dispatch/serialization; worker stages use worker-local clock, never subtract absolute cross-thread times. push combines input copy, inflate and attribute consumption; finish includes finalization/export. Memory values are WASM linear-memory capacity at boundaries, NOT live heap/peak process/GPU memory. Total ends after settle/draw submission. No production optimization or format change.
